title: Searching for the Best Deal Events of the Summer? We Have All the Details Here - CNET
snippet: According to 9to5Toys, Best Buy will kick off its sale a day before Amazon and run for a full week. A rep for the retailer has reportedly said this will be one of its “biggest sale events of the summer.” There will be savings on all the usual tech, including laptops, TVs and home appliances from top brands. There will also be “exclusive offers” for My Best Buy Plus and Total members. [...] Target is bringing back its Circle Deal Days. The four-day sale event will offer up to 45% off thousands of items across all categories, including back-to-school gear. The event kicks off on June 23, but members of Target Circle 360, the paid membership tier, will get early access starting June 22. [...] We’re expecting to see massive discounts from all your favorite retailers, which is a win for everyone. To help you make the most of the events this month, we’ve gathered all the details in one place. We’ll keep this article updated as more dates are announced. As of right now, we can confirm that Amazon, Target and Walmart have all announced official dates for later this month. Best Buy is also preparing to announce its own sale, according to a report from 9to5Toys. Here’s what we know:

snippet:
